I am an old man now, 67 years, and I have farmed this land in Mzimba for many seasons. My main maize plot is small, only 0.61 hectares near the homestead, so I must treat it well because this is where our nsima comes from. I will buy some fertilizer if I can get the AIP coupon like last year, and I keep cattle and goats so I spread their manure on this plot before the rains. I intercrop with pigeon peas and pumpkins as my father taught me, and my sons and their wives help with the weeding since my back is not what it was.
